Settings.QueryText: SELECT ServiceRegistration.Ref AS Ref, ServiceRegistration.Date AS Date, ServiceRegistration.Room AS Room, ServiceRegistration.Client.FullName AS ClientFullName, ROUND(ServiceRegistration.Quantity, 0) AS Quantity, ServiceRegistration.Posted AS Posted, ServiceRegistration.ParentDoc.AccommodationType AS ParentDocAccommodationType, ServiceRegistration.Service AS Service FROM Document.ServiceRegistration AS ServiceRegistration

CalculatedField.dcssch:expression: CASE WHEN Posted THEN NStr("en='Registered'; de='Eingetragen'; ru='Зарегистрирована'") ELSE NStr("en='Cancelled'; de='Abgesagt'; ru='Отменена'") END
